menu_options.smartemis_auto: Detect automatically from the Smartemis app

smartemis_auto.title: Detect Smartemis phoneId
smartemis_auto.description: Temporary local capture only. On the phone, edit the current Wi-Fi network proxy. Prefer Automatic/PAC and enter {pac_url}. If PAC is unavailable, use Manual proxy {proxy_host}:{proxy_port}. Then open Smartemis once and return here to press Submit. The proxy handles only the official Smartemis directory host, stops automatically, stores no traffic, and never logs the raw phoneId. Remove the Wi-Fi proxy after detection.

smartemis_manual.title: Enter Smartemis phoneId
smartemis_manual.description: Enter the phoneId already registered by the official Smartemis app. Home Assistant reuses it and never registers a second device.

smartemis_service.title: Select Smartemis service
smartemis_service.description: Choose the service used by your official Smartemis app.
